extracted_concepts.name: Cosine Rule

extracted_concepts.name: Conditional Probability
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Probability of an event given that another event has occurred.

extracted_concepts.name: Mean
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Arithmetic average calculated by summing values and dividing by count.

extracted_concepts.name: Median
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Middle value in an ordered dataset.

extracted_concepts.name: Frequency Tables
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Tabular display showing how often each value occurs in a dataset.

extracted_concepts.name: Venn Diagrams
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Visual representation of sets and their logical relationships.

extracted_concepts.name: Radians
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Unit of angular measure where one radian equals radius length along circumference.

extracted_concepts.name: Logarithms
extracted_concepts.definition_snippet: Inverse operation to exponentiation, solving for the power.
